AUTHORED FOR THIS PRODUCT. No template or sibling residue: grep of the frozen task for CHANGE_ME, change-me, PatchPad, incident, other sibling product names returns nothing (only the template-controlled key prompt_template). The template ships 'CHANGE_ME' in instruction.md, app_context.md, notes.md and task.toml name/description/keywords/provenance/arena_slice; every one is replaced with product-specific content: task.toml:5 name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools", :6 description = "A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions.", :15 arena_slice = "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history". instruction.md:1 is a first-person product request specific to this product ('I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source'). All five prompts open 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground' and app_context.md:3-14 describes this app (no accounts, one workspace at /, .js/.html filename chooses run mode). All 55 criterion ids carry the cw_ prefix and describe playground behaviour. Golden package.json name is colderwater-playground-devtools.

NOT A NOUNS-SWAPPED CLONE. The nearest sibling by concept is projects/patchpad-editor(-v2,-v3) (custom incident-report editor: from-scratch surface, multi-caret, undo, find/replace, SQLite revisions, stale-save conflict). Colderwater shares that editor/revision core, and shows shared lineage (same banned-editor list in ui.md:3 vs patchpad overview.md:34; the multi-caret probe word MULTI in cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic and in patchpad multi_caret_full_typing_single_undo). But the flows and criteria are not the same with renamed entities: (a) about 24 of the 43 Functional criteria grade behaviour PatchPad has no counterpart for - cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring, cw_js/html_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_format_error_keeps_draft, cw_basic_run_output, cw_html_preview, cw_error_message_and_line, cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_run_starts_fresh_document, cw_console_levels_in_order, cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_time_limit_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft, cw_same_line_carets, cw_caret_kept_in_view; (b) the data model differs (many titled .js/.html snippets in a shared library with an empty seed, vs one seeded incident document from incident_seed.json); (c) PatchPad criteria with no Colderwater counterpart exist too (seed_document_integrity, noop_save_revision_invariant, manifest_documents_runtime_routes, direct_api_save_rejection_nonmutation_matrix, word navigation shortcuts, selection autoscroll); (d) where the concept overlaps the text is independently written and the semantics differ - e.g. PatchPad restore makes the editor dirty with the server unchanged ('require the editor to become dirty with revision-1 content while the server remains unchanged'), while Colderwater restore commits ('the snippet must get a fourth revision whose title, filename and source equal the first'); PatchPad stale-save chains A/B conflicts on fixed markers TAB-A-WINS, Colderwater splits refusal and draft preservation over title, filename and source; the multi-caret criterion adds a three-second pause inside one burst and requires both modifiers. PatchPad is also on the retired dimensions layout (tests/reward.toml), with 'Feature metadata:' prefixes absent here. No other sibling in projects/ (commerce, spreadsheet, canvas, games, claims, recruiting, chat, etc.) is a code playground; grep of all sibling instruction.md/task.toml for playground/code editor/caret hits only this task and PatchPad.

Broken-clone test: a PatchPad golden with nouns renamed would fail the Run-dependent, formatting, colouring, isolation and live-library criteria, so a renamed sibling does not satisfy this rubric; conversely a conforming playground is not asked for any PatchPad-only artefact (seeded document, APP_MANIFEST.md).

DOMAIN PLAN. The slug suffix -devtools, category 'programming', keyword 'devtools' and arena_slice are mutually consistent and no other task in projects/ occupies a devtools/code-playground slot. NOTE 1: no suite domain-plan document exists in the frozen rules or the workspace, so 'fits the suite's domain plan' is judged from sibling names and this task's metadata only, not against a plan. NOTE 2: task.toml:14 provenance = "Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task." - the task is an adaptation of a supplied original that I could not inspect; distinctness from that original is not what this row measures and was not assessed. NOTE 3 (P3, lineage): roughly 16 editor-core Functional criteria (typing/line join, navigation, graphemes, mouse selection, paste undo, block indent, multi-caret typing/delete, find/replace x3, save-restart, stale save x2, history restore) cover the same concepts as PatchPad; if both ship in one suite there is partial skill overlap, but it is under half the rubric and none is copied text. This row needs no runtime measurement; the scripted golden results and the earlier-candidate hosted run in the evidence index were hash-verified but are not relied on for this verdict.
